name: Chicken Shawarma
recipeIngredient: Pita bread and tahini sauce for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all spices with oil, lemon juice, and garlic to make marinade.
Add chicken and marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Heat a large skillet over high heat.
Cook chicken in batches until golden and cooked through.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Serve in pita bread with tomatoes, onions, and tahini sauce.

keywords: chicken shawarma, Middle Eastern chicken, spiced chicken, wraps
